_comment: Practice envelope for claim submission (837P). EVERYTHING here is dynamic: the submitter re-reads this file (mtime-cached) on every run, so edits take effect immediately without a code change or restart. Fields marked REQUIRED block submission (fail closed, per claim, with a precise reason) when missing — they never crash the pipeline.

billing_provider._comment: REQUIRED. The practice entity that gets paid (837P loop 2010AA).

rendering_providers._comment: Rendering provider resolution, in order: (1) an entry here whose 'match' matches the note's provider name (case-insensitive substring); (2) the note's own extracted NPI if it is a valid 10-digit number; (3) 'default' below; else the claim BLOCKS. Add providers as the practice roster changes — nothing else to update.

service_facility._comment: Optional (837P loop 2310C). Used when the note's place of service is a facility (POS facility indicator from the CMS POS code set); omit or null to bill without a separate facility loop.

fee_schedule._comment: REQUIRED per billed code: charge per unit in USD. A claim line whose code is absent BLOCKS the claim (policy below) — the system never invents a charge. Keep this in sync with the practice's charge master.

claim_defaults._comment: 837P claim-level indicators. claim_filing_code is resolved per payer: payer_overrides (by payer_id from data/codes/payers.json), then by_kind, then 'default'.

submission_policy._comment: Which verified claims may transmit. verification_tiers: registry tiers allowed to submit. require_clean_disposition should stay true.
